featured_reviews.name: Sofia Quinn
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ Strong and Serious Review of Raigad Military School

(Please read this carefully and take action.)

Raigad Military School has a large campus and good infrastructure, but many students feel that important issues inside the school are being ignored. These problems affect discipline, safety, and the overall learning environment.

One major concern raised by students is that some forms of inappropriate behaviour like dating in school are not being addressed properly. Students have reported cases of misconduct, use of foul language, and bringing prohibited or harmful items to school, yet strict action is not always taken. When such behaviour is ignored, it sends a message that rules are not important, and this can influence other students in a negative way. A school should ensure a safe and disciplined atmosphere, and students expect the institute head to take these matters seriously.

Another concern is that favouritism sometimes affects discipline, as some students are overlooked despite repeated issues, while well-behaved students feel unprotected. This makes many students feel that paying fees is valued more than maintaining a healthy environment. Such practices harm the school’s reputation and encourage other students to behave carelessly.

Students strongly feel that the school should take strict action against prohibited items, bad behaviour, and activities that are not acceptable on school premises. Clear rules, proper monitoring, and equal treatment for all students are necessary to create a safe and respectful atmosphere.

The sports system also needs serious improvement. The school has a big playground but rarely allows students to use it. Sports periods are cancelled frequently, sometimes because of the mistake of one child while the whole class is punished. Even Sports Day is limited only to the school, with no participation in inter-school competitions or district-level events. This discourages students who want to grow in sports and represent the school outside.

Students also feel that teaching quality needs attention. Some teachers struggle with communication skills, and instead of boosting confidence, students often feel discouraged. Education should inspire students, not lower their self-belief.

Overall, Raigad Military School has potential, but many areas require urgent and serious improvement. The school must enforce discipline fairly, strengthen sports opportunities, support student talent, take action on misconduct, and create a safer and more encouraging environment. Only then will students truly feel supported, respected, and motivated to do their best.

featured_reviews.name: Arjun Munde
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Paradigm of Excellence: Raigad Military School, Andheri West

Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5)

As a proud parent, I am thrilled to share my experience with the Raigad Military School in Andheri West. From the moment we enrolled our child, it was evident that this institution is dedicated to fostering holistic growth and preparing students for a bright future.

The school's infrastructure is impressive, providing a conducive environment for learning. The classrooms are spacious, well-equipped with modern technology, and designed to inspire creativity and collaboration. The sprawling campus boasts state-of-the-art sports facilities, allowing students to excel in various athletic pursuits. The emphasis on physical fitness and discipline is truly commendable.

What sets Raigad Military School apart is its exceptional faculty. The teachers are not just academically qualified but also possess a genuine passion for nurturing young minds. They employ innovative teaching methodologies, ensuring that each student receives personalized attention and encouragement. The school's commitment to instilling strong moral values and fostering leadership skills is truly praiseworthy.

Academically, the school provides a comprehensive curriculum that combines theoretical knowledge with practical application. The focus on experiential learning and critical thinking has helped my child develop a deep understanding of various subjects. Regular assessments and feedback mechanisms keep parents well-informed about their child's progress.

Moreover, the school offers a wide range of co-curricular activities, including cultural events, music, arts, and sports clubs, allowing students to explore their interests beyond the classroom. The annual sports day and cultural fest are grand affairs, showcasing the immense talent of the students.

In conclusion, Raigad Military School in Andheri West is a beacon of excellence in education. With its unwavering commitment to academic excellence, character development, and overall growth, the institution has truly surpassed our expectations. I wholeheartedly recommend this school to parents seeking a nurturing and well-rounded education for their children.
